tasks.title: Implement Core macOS Interaction Backend
tasks.description: Complete the implementation of the macOS interaction backend in src-tauri/mcp-server-os-level/src/platforms/macos/engine.rs to provide comprehensive tools for interacting with the macOS environment.
tasks.details:
This task involves implementing all 'todo' functions in the macOS engine.rs file, including:
1. Window management functions (get title, list, close, minimize, resize, move)
2. UI element interaction via Accessibility APIs
3. Keyboard and mouse emulation
4. Screenshot capture
5. Clipboard access

Each function should return a rich `ToolResult` object that includes:
- textual output
- error information
- base64 encoded screenshots where applicable

Implementation should use native macOS APIs including CoreGraphics and Accessibility frameworks. Ensure proper error handling and documentation for each function.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for each function to verify correct behavior. Test with various macOS applications to ensure compatibility. Create integration tests that chain multiple functions together to simulate real-world usage. Document any limitations discovered during testing, especially regarding multi-monitor setups.

subtasks.title: Implement get_window_title and list_windows functions
subtasks.description: Implement the get_window_title and list_windows functions using macOS CoreGraphics and Accessibility APIs
subtasks.details:
1. Research CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo API for window enumeration
2. Implement get_window_title to retrieve the title of a window by ID
3. Implement list_windows to return all visible windows with their IDs and titles
4. Add error handling for cases like invalid window IDs or permission issues
5. Format results as ToolResult objects with appropriate text output
6. Add screenshot capability to list_windows function using CGWindowListCreateImage
7. Write unit tests for both functions with mock window scenarios

subtasks.title: Implement close_window and minimize_window functions
subtasks.description: Implement window control functions for closing and minimizing windows using Accessibility APIs
subtasks.details:
1. Research AXUIElementRef API for window manipulation
2. Implement close_window function to properly close a window by ID
3. Implement minimize_window function to minimize a window to Dock
4. Handle permission issues with Accessibility API access
5. Add robust error handling for non-existent windows
6. Create ToolResult objects with operation status and screenshots
7. Test with various application windows including system dialogs

subtasks.title: Implement resize_window and move_window functions
subtasks.description: Implement window positioning functions using CoreGraphics and Accessibility APIs
subtasks.details:
1. Research CGWindowID to AXUIElementRef conversion techniques
2. Implement resize_window to change window dimensions
3. Implement move_window to reposition windows on screen
4. Handle multi-monitor setups and screen boundaries
5. Add validation for input parameters (coordinates and dimensions)
6. Create ToolResult objects with before/after screenshots
7. Test with windows of different applications and window types

subtasks.title: Implement UI element interaction and keyboard/mouse emulation
subtasks.description: Implement functions for UI interaction and input device emulation
subtasks.details:
1. Research CGEventPost for keyboard and mouse event simulation
2. Implement functions to find and interact with UI elements using AXUIElementRef
3. Create keyboard input simulation with support for modifier keys
4. Implement mouse movement, clicking and dragging operations
5. Handle coordinate systems and screen scaling factors
6. Add appropriate error handling for all operations
7. Test with various applications and UI controls

subtasks.title: Implement screenshot capture and clipboard access
subtasks.description: Implement functions for capturing screenshots and accessing clipboard content
subtasks.details:
1. Research CGDisplayCreateImage for full screen capture
2. Implement region-based screenshot functionality
3. Add window-specific screenshot capability
4. Research NSPasteboard API for clipboard access
5. Implement functions to read and write clipboard text and images
6. Convert captured images to base64 for ToolResult objects
7. Test with various content types and applications
8. Add comprehensive documentation for all implemented functions

tasks.title: Design and Implement ToolResult and ToolCollection Primitives
tasks.description: Create the foundational data structures for tool management and result handling that will be used by all agents in the system.
tasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for each component. Test serialization/deserialization of ToolDescription and ToolResult. Create mock tools to verify ToolCollection functionality. Ensure thread safety if these primitives will be accessed from multiple threads.

tasks.title: Implement Basic Agent Structure
tasks.description: Create the foundational agent architecture including BaseAgent trait, ReActAgent, and ToolCallAgent implementations.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for each agent type. Test the ReAct loop with mock LLM responses. Verify that ToolCallAgent correctly parses and executes tool calls. Test memory management and conversation history. Ensure agents handle errors gracefully and respect max_steps limits.

tasks.title: Implement LLM Interface Module
tasks.description: Create a flexible LLM interaction module that can interface with various LLM providers, with initial focus on Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests with mock API responses. Test error handling for API failures. Test with actual API calls (using environment variables for keys). Verify image encoding functions. Test with various message formats including those with images.

tasks.title: Implement MacOSInteractionAgent
tasks.description: Create the specialized MacOSInteractionAgent that inherits from ToolCallAgent and is equipped with macOS-specific tools.
tasks.testStrategy: Test each tool individually with the macOS engine. Create integration tests for the MacOSInteractionAgent with simple tasks like opening an application, clicking a button, etc. Test the agent's ability to use both visual information (screenshots) and structural information (accessibility data). Document any limitations discovered during testing.

tasks.title: Implement Simple Execution Loop and UI Feedback
tasks.description: Create a basic execution loop that allows a user to input a task, have it processed by the MacOSInteractionAgent, and see the results in the Tauri UI.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the Tauri commands with simple tasks. Verify that the UI correctly displays the agent's thoughts, actions, and screenshots. Test the stop functionality to ensure it properly interrupts the agent. Test with various task complexities to ensure the UI remains responsive.

tasks.title: Design and Implement Plan and PlanStep Data Structures
tasks.description: Create the data structures needed for the PlanManager to manage multi-step plans.
tasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for all struct methods. Test serialization/deserialization. Test plan status transitions and step management. Ensure thread safety if these structures will be accessed from multiple threads.

tasks.title: Implement PlanManager Component
tasks.description: Create the PlanManager component responsible for generating plans from user goals and orchestrating their execution.
tasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for plan generation with mock LLM responses. Test plan execution with mock agents. Test error handling for failed steps. Test plan cancellation. Create integration tests that combine plan generation and execution with real agents for simple tasks.

tasks.title: Enhance UI for Plan Display and Control
tasks.description: Extend the Tauri UI to display the plan generated by the PlanManager and provide controls for managing plan execution.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the Tauri commands with simple plans. Verify that the UI correctly displays the plan and updates as steps are completed. Test the cancel functionality. Test with plans of varying complexity. Ensure the UI remains responsive during plan execution.

tasks.title: Implement FileSystemAgent
tasks.description: Create a specialized agent for file system operations.
tasks.testStrategy: Test each file system tool individually. Create integration tests for the FileSystemAgent with tasks like creating directories, copying files, etc. Test error handling for file operations. Test with various file types and sizes. Ensure the agent respects file permissions and handles errors gracefully.

tasks.title: Implement Basic WebNavigationAgent
tasks.description: Create a specialized agent for web browser interactions.
tasks.testStrategy: Test each web navigation tool individually. Create integration tests for the WebNavigationAgent with tasks like opening a browser, navigating to a URL, filling out a form, etc. Test with various websites to ensure compatibility. Document any limitations discovered during testing, especially regarding dynamic content and JavaScript-heavy sites.

tasks.title: Implement UserInteractionAgent
tasks.description: Create a specialized agent for interacting with the user to clarify tasks or request additional information.
tasks.testStrategy: Test each user interaction tool individually. Create integration tests for the UserInteractionAgent with various interaction types. Test the Tauri events for user interactions. Test timeout handling for pending interactions. Ensure the agent can handle multiple pending interactions simultaneously.

tasks.title: Implement InformationRetrievalAgent
tasks.description: Create a specialized agent for web searches and document reading.
tasks.testStrategy: Test each information retrieval tool individually. Create integration tests for the InformationRetrievalAgent with tasks like searching for information, reading web pages, etc. Test with various search queries and web pages. Test error handling for network issues and parsing errors.

tasks.title: Enhance PlanManager for Multi-Agent Orchestration
tasks.description: Extend the PlanManager to intelligently select and dispatch tasks to the most appropriate specialized agent.
tasks.testStrategy: Test agent registration and retrieval. Test plan generation with agent selection. Test step execution with different agents. Test error handling when an agent is not found. Create integration tests that involve multiple agents working together on a complex task.

tasks.title: Implement Hybrid Perception for MacOSInteractionAgent
tasks.description: Enhance the MacOSInteractionAgent to utilize both visual information (screenshots) and structural information (from Accessibility APIs) for more robust interaction.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the hybrid perception with various macOS applications. Compare the effectiveness of accessibility-based interaction versus visual-based interaction. Test with applications known to have poor accessibility support. Test the fallback tools for visual interaction. Document any limitations discovered during testing.

tasks.title: Implement Advanced Error Handling and Recovery
tasks.description: Enhance all agents with robust error handling and recovery mechanisms to improve task completion reliability.
tasks.testStrategy: Test each error pattern and recovery strategy. Create scenarios that trigger specific errors and verify that the recovery mechanisms work as expected. Test with applications known to be problematic. Test the replanning capability of the PlanManager. Document any limitations discovered during testing.

tasks.title: Implement Workspace Management Module
tasks.description: Create a module for preparing and managing temporary, isolated contexts or directories for agents performing sensitive operations.
tasks.testStrategy: Test workspace creation, file operations, and cleanup. Verify that workspaces are properly isolated. Test concurrent access to workspaces. Test error handling for file operations. Ensure that workspaces are properly cleaned up when no longer needed.

tasks.title: Implement Configuration Management
tasks.description: Create a module for managing user configuration, including API keys, agent preferences, and other settings.
tasks.testStrategy: Test configuration loading, saving, and updating. Test with various configuration values. Test error handling for invalid configurations. Ensure that sensitive information like API keys is handled securely. Test the default configuration generation.

tasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Logging System
tasks.description: Create a robust logging system for debugging, troubleshooting, and auditing agent actions.
tasks.testStrategy: Test log creation, flushing, and retrieval. Test with various log levels, components, and session IDs. Test concurrent logging from multiple threads. Test log rotation and cleanup. Ensure that logs are properly formatted and contain all necessary information for debugging.

tasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Testing Framework
tasks.description: Create a testing framework for evaluating agent performance and reliability across various tasks and applications.
tasks.testStrategy: Create a set of test cases covering various macOS applications and tasks. Test the validation mechanisms for different validation types. Test concurrent test execution. Test result reporting and logging. Use the testing framework to evaluate the performance and reliability of the agents.
